name: smwgraphics-ardy-lightfoot-visconti-s-castle
title: Ardy Lightfoot - Visconti's Castle
description:
This is a rip from the game Ardy Lightfoot.

This rip contains an FG and 4 different Backgrounds.

It uses all palettes, but it doesn't overwrite the status bar and the first 9 palettes from row 6 (for the sake of coins and question blocks).

MWL's are included for each of the backgrounds, the tileset also has exanimation.

Credits would be nice since this took me a while, but they aren't necessary.

Lunar magic 1.70 or higher required.
